title: SceneAxi catalog listings with dual pricing (v1)
description: Committed test-mode listing SKUs. A seller decides what an asset costs and in which currency: credits, money, or both. creditPrice is required exactly when priceMode includes credits and moneyPrice exactly when it includes money; a price the mode excludes must be absent, because a dormant field is how a credits-only listing quietly acquires a money price later. That cross-field rule is enforced by validateCatalogListing in packages/schemas/src/catalog-listing.ts — this schema states the per-field shape, and pnpm check:contracts keeps the docs/auth-credits.md table in exact lockstep with the fixture. Test mode only: live price ids are a separate captain go-live decision. Deliberately expressed in the JSON Schema subset scripts/check-contracts.mjs supports.

mode.description: Constant: only test-mode listings are committed to the repository.

listings.description: At least three, so credits-only, money-only, and dual-price listings are all exercised.

sellerUserId.description: The creator who earns the revenue share on a sale.

creditPrice.description: Present exactly when priceMode includes credits.

moneyPrice.description: Present exactly when priceMode includes money.

unitAmount.description: Price in the currency's minor unit.

stripePriceId.description: Test-mode price id only. Price ids are public identifiers, unlike API keys, which live only in env.

publishedAt.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit timezone. validateCatalogListing applies the full shared expression; this is the gate-subset form.
